podcast.title: Post-High School Band
podcast.body: After finishing high school, Gord Downie joined The Filters, a band that also featured his classmate Phine McConnell. "When Gord finished high school, he joined up with a band called The Filters, which featured classmate Phine McConnell."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Enrollment in Film Studies
xref.body: After finishing high school and playing with The Filters, Gord grew tired of performing punky covers and decided to enroll in film studies at Queen's University. It was there that he reconnected with Rob Baker and Gord Sinclair, leading to the formation of The Tragically Hip. "Eventually Gord got tired of playing the punky covers and left to enroll in film studies at Queens, and that's where he ran into Rob Baker and Gord Sinclair again."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Future Band of Member
xref.body: Phine McConnell, a classmate of Gord Downie and a member of The Filters, was later associated with a group called The Mahomes. "a guy who would later show up in the Mahomes."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
